//: One Vercel project serving both hostnames: saathi.dev is the static site in site/,
api.saathi.dev is rewritten onto the Hono function in api/. Attach both domains to this
project in the Vercel dashboard; Vercel prints the exact DNS records to add at Porkbun.
The build command is a gate, not a build: there is nothing to compile (the site is plain
HTML and Vercel compiles the function itself), but a deploy whose generated contract has
drifted from the schema would ship a backend whose route list disagrees with the clients.
On the headers below: the CSP is scoped away from /api because it describes the page, not the
JSON API. HTML is cached for only 5 minutes because the static assets are not fingerprinted —
cache it hard and a deploy takes an hour to become visible.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.saathi.dev; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
